Input image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE COMPOSITION reference: a light paper website with a central app and an organic network of machines and mushrooms around its sides. Input image 2 is the AUTHORITATIVE ILLUSTRATION STYLE reference: Mycellios's finely engraved industrial computer modules, porous ivory mycelium and realistic mushrooms.
Generate ONLY THE BACKGROUND ART on a truly transparent wide landscape canvas, approximately 2:1. Absolutely NO app window, user interface, buttons, typography, wordmark, logo, letters, or page background. Do not reproduce any of the screenshot's UI.

Interweave the islands using richly textured branching, porous ivory mycelium, thin dark green fibers and roots, open lace holes and arcs. Tiny sparse olive/gold spores and a little moss. Lots of intricate engraved botanical and metal detail. Ivory, muted moss green, charcoal/forest ink and touches of warm ochre; restrained natural colors for a warm off-white webpage. Fine stippled and etched drawing with depth, like the supplied reference; no flat icon look and no glossy 3D plastic.
The central upper region must stay genuinely empty and transparent for the real hero copy. Keep all elements within the canvas, with organic irregular edges and transparent gaps between stems/fibers. No trees, fog, solid backdrop, rectangular floor, neon lighting, badges, extra objects, watermark or text. One usable transparent botanical computing-network illustration, not a website mockup.
